about_the_game:
This Skin pack adds a halloween themed skin for your towers

to activate the skin click ingame on the menu button for skins and click on the Halloween button.
Directly after activating the skin, all new towers will be built with the skin, after an restart also the other towers are shown with the skin.

Happy Halloween
